In which year did the academy have the highest enrolment?
solution:
**Calculation**

The academy enrolment in 2018 = 46 + 34 + 42 + 37 + 45 + 35 = 239

The academy enrolment in 2019 = 40 + 41 + 44 + 34 + 42 + 32 = 233

The academy enrolment in 2020 = 43 + 40 + 40 + 32 + 38 + 36 = 229

The academy enrolment in 2021 = 37 + 44 + 43 + 25 + 34 + 28 = 211

The academy enrolment in 2022 = 34 + 41 + 41 + 32 + 41 + 39 = 228

**The highest enrolment is in 2018.**
